task: matched-date demand-only versus schedule-aware ridership regression
evaluation_type: retrospective rolling one-step; prior observed rides can include earlier test dates
interpretation: The comparison measures association/predictive value on historically matched dates. It is not causal and does not establish an operational fixed-origin forecast.

fixed_origin_evaluation.daytype_assumption: CTA daytype is treated as known date/calendar metadata; confirm the operational calendar source

hybrid_walk_forward_development.evaluation_type: Monthly-refit, daily rolling one-step development folds. Hybrid policy is chosen from completed prior folds only; test-day lags use observed earlier rides and schedule snapshots available by each service date. August was previously inspected.
